description: Review decisions applied when variants.json is built. A spelling listed as reject is dropped; keep marks it reviewed. Links attach an external record the automatic linking left out ('none' records it as not a current place).
reviewer: Independent AI agent (Claude) reviewed everything on 2026-10-31. Amin reviewed the agent-filled review page on 2026-11-01, decided the 17 spellings added after it ('by': 'amin'), and agreed with every rule. 'by' names who made each decision.
rules_amin: Amin agreed with all 9 rules on 2026-10-31, before the agent's review; rule 3 was then changed to keep 'area' after the agent's objection.

rules.rule: Arabic ی and ک (Persian keyboard forms) are mapped to ي and ك.
rules.note: Persian-keyboard ی/ک are common in typed Arabic; mapping to ي/ك is safe

rules.rule: Latin accents are removed (BĀW -> baw), and apostrophes and ʿ are dropped (Ad Du'ayn -> duain after the other rules).
rules.note: Accents and apostrophes/ayn marks vary freely between transliterations; no official pair is merged

rules.rule: Generic words are dropped: state, locality, district, province, town, IDPs, camp, village(s), area, ولاية, محلية. مدينة is kept because two official names contain it.
rules.note: Dropping "area" makes "Abyei Area" key to "abyai", identical to locality SD18087 Abyei, while "Abyei Area" normally means the Abyei PCA area (SD19/SD19001). Keep "area" (or special-case Abyei). Dropping "province" also lets old provinces (Blue Nile Province, Northern Province) match current states; acceptable only with level filtering

rules.rule: A glued al/el (Elfasher, Alfashir) is stripped when at least four letters remain.
rules.note: Glued al/el is common (Elfasher, Alsoky, Elgirba); 4-letter minimum avoids stripping short real words; no official names collide

rules.rule: Synonyms: translated direction and descriptor words map to the transliterations official names use (north -> shamal, west -> gharb, rural -> reifi, city -> madinat, بلدية -> مدينة, غربية -> غرب).
rules.note: Translated direction/descriptor words map consistently on both sides; matches official COD-AB forms

rules.rule: Skeleton (fuzzy scoring only): q, gh and j count as g; kh as k; dh as d; th as t; w as u; y as i; vowels after the first letter are ignored.
rules.note: Fine for fuzzy scoring only (Gedaref/Qadarif, Jebel/Gebel), but note it gives identical skeletons to distinct places: Al Qureisha/Al Qurashi (grsh), As Sunta/As Sunut (snt), Bahri/Al Buhaira (bhr), Buram/Al Buram, Tendalti/Tendelti; must not be used as an exact key and needs state hints

rules.rule: ey and aw are unified with ai and au (Khowey / Khiwai, Baw / Bau, Awlia / Aulia).
rules.note: ey/ei/ay/ai and aw/au are free transliteration variants of the same Arabic diphthongs

rules.rule: A final h after a vowel is dropped (Jazirah / Gezira, Bandah / Banda, Jabrah / Jabra): the Latin counterpart of ة -> ه.
rules.note: Mirrors ة->ه; side effect: real final ح is also dropped (Wadi Salih -> wadi sali) but this creates no collision

rules.rule: Synonyms are applied in an extra key: names are matched both with and without them, so a typo in a translated word (Centeral Darfur) still matches.
rules.note: Matching with and without synonyms only adds recall for typos; key is still exact
